blocks.x: Can you think of any other significant trumpet players or anyone I mean like Jabbo(?)?
He's from Arkansas. That's a little bit before your time. Someone was asking me about him not so long ago.
Did you all work together at, you and Ed Swayzee?
No, we did for a while, yeah.
They had a show. You know, like you travel and we'd play together.
Do you remember what the name of the show was or whose show handled, whose show was that that you traveled with?
